limitations: Only the within-row serial laboratory comparisons are kept as series: serum creatinine and proteinuria at baseline, peak, biopsy and follow-up in Tables 3 and 5.
Other cells of Tables 1 to 5, including the Table 4 grading grid, are single-time pathology or descriptor cells and are not turned into series; coverage is therefore limited.

The Pt 11 peak proteinuria cells in Tables 3 and 5 differ and are kept as separate cells in separate series.
